verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents some first-party bulk capabilities: batch case creation through the case import API, batched FinCEN filing submission, and multi-file attachment import within a case. These are mostly create or submit operations. There is no evidence of bulk edit, reassign, close or delete actions across many existing cases, and the API reference is password-gated, so depth can't be verified. Missing for 10: bulk update/disposition/assignment across many existing items, a public API reference documenting batch endpoints and their limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Hummingbird also supports batch creating cases over the case import API. This is preferable for use cases where it's desirable to create many cases all at once
Batching Filing enables a filing organization to send filings to FinCEN in batches instead of one filing at a time.
You can add one or more attachments (bulk import) in the Files tab from within a case
